titulo: Building Damage Assessment in Viterbo Town, Caldas Department, Colombia  as of 12 August 2026
descripcion:
This map illustrates structures and buildings affected by the magnitude 7.4 earthquake with an epicentre south of San José del Palmar town in Colombia, with analysis focused on Viterbo in Caldas Department, approximately 50 km from the mainshock epicentre. Damage and destruction were identified primarily using Pleiades very-high-resolution satellite imagery acquired on 12 August 2026. In this area 42 buildings were identified as damaged and 66 were identified potentially damaged buildings. 

This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Ground verification is encouraged, and feedback can be sent to the United Nations Satellite Centre.

titulo: PRELIMINARY SATELLITE-DERIVED DAMAGE ASSESSMENT - San José Del Palmar municipality, Chocó department, Colombia
descripcion:
SUMMARY OF FINDING
Satellite imagery dated 11 August 2026 confirms visible structural damage on one building and possible debris in San José del Palmar municipality.
Satellite imagery dated 11 August 2026 confirms possibly induced landslide along the departmental route, San José del Palmar-Ansermanuevo / RD48-02, in San José del Palmar municipality.
No other visible widespread structural damage could be observed from satellite imagery in San José del Palmar town within the cloud-free areas  as of 11 August 2026.
